title: Google Business Profile Checklist for Contractors (2026)
meta: The Google Business Profile checklist for contractors: complete every field, post weekly, add job photos, and build reviews — 91% won't consider a shop under 4 stars.
short: Your Google Business Profile is your storefront, and most contractors leave it half-empty. The checklist: complete every field, add job photos weekly, post weekly, and build steady reviews — because 91% of homeowners won't consider a shop under 4 stars.
statLabel: Of homeowners won't consider a business under 4 stars (BrightLocal 2026)

body.answer: Google ranks complete profiles over lazy ones.
body.html: Services, service areas, hours, description, categories — fill it all. A complete profile is the baseline for showing up in the map pack, where homeowners actually pick a contractor.
Add job photos every week and post offers/tips/finished jobs like it's social. Fresh-photo, actively-posted profiles get more calls and direction requests — it's free real estate on the results page.

91% won't consider a shop under 4 stars (BrightLocal 2026), and recent reviews with keywords ('water heater install') push you up the pack. Ask every customer, one-tap link, never gate or pay (fake reviews are illegal as of FTC 2024).

faq.q: How do I rank my contractor business on Google Maps?
faq.a: Complete every profile field, add job photos and posts weekly, and build steady recent reviews with service keywords. 91% of homeowners won't consider a shop under 4 stars (BrightLocal 2026).

faq.q: How often should I post on Google Business Profile?
faq.a: Weekly — offers, tips, finished jobs. Active, fresh-photo profiles earn more calls and direction requests than static ones.

faq.q: Do Google Business Profile reviews affect ranking?
faq.a: Yes — count, recency, and keyword relevance all influence the map pack. Steady velocity beats a big old pile that's gone quiet.
